page.layout: One column of running text, with a centred heading "Parerga." and numbered paragraphs below. A small footnote in smaller type sits under the first paragraph. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: tutibus iam constitutis siue ipso iure, siue tuitione Prætoris: Nam de promissis aut venditis tantum, nec dum cōstitutis, ut eæ imponantur, competunt Actiones in personam, ut Condictio incerti, vel Actio ex empto. {s}
{s}j.[?] l. 35 Sibinatum[?]. D. de Ser. præ. urb. l. 8. D. de Act. emp. l. 22. §. 1. D. de Cond. ind.

p.i: Ex his facile iam est, & Definitionem harum Actionū elicere, u.g. Confessoria est Actio Ciuilis in rem, qua Seruitus prædij vindicatur: & Formulā siue Libellum: cuius non quatuor sunt capita, ut pragmatici numerant, sed unum hoc princeps, quo Actor dicat, tale ius ad se pertinere, vel neget, alteri tale ius esse, ut eundi, altius tollendi: cui capiti accedere potest, ut dicat, Actor se in suo illo iure per hunc impediri.

main_text.head: Parerga.
main_text.p: Successorem Regni, aut Ciuitatis, teneri æs alienum, ab An-tecessore, publico aut Reip. nomine contractum, dissoluere.

Magistratum, qui vel sontem, ut latronem, vel hostem per-secutus in alieni iuris vicino & non hostili territorio ceperit, restituere eum Magistratui aut Principi eius loci debere: & hoc amplius, de iniuria eidem satisfacere.
Quamuis Proportionum tres adferantur species, Arithme-tica, Geometrica, & Harmonica: Recte tamen ab Aristotele Iustitiam in duas tantum species tributam videri, Permutatio-nis, & Diuisionis. IIII.
Recte à Veteribus à Baptismo Christi ad eius mortem nu-merari quatuor tantum Paschata.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the footnote mark after "empto." and the first letter of the footnote ("j.") are uncertain; "Sibinatum" may be "Si binarum" or similar. "XXXX III." is printed as such (possibly a misprint for XXXIII). "illo iure" has a small mark between the words, possibly a printer's dot. The "IIII." after "Diuisionis." stands at the end of the line as printed. The first word of the page is a fragment and continues from the previous page. The "Formulā" tilde is read as a macron-like abbreviation mark and may be "Formula". Right-hand edge shows a clip and show-through, which were left out.
